messages:
elaine_sales: FYI — Prospect (Finova) wants a quick POC to replace VendorX API. They care about prompt parity and identical response formatting. Can we run a short feasibility sweep? :eyes:

mike_se: quick yes. main questions: how close do they need to be? token-for-token parity or functional parity (same intents + similar outputs)?

elaine_sales: They asked for 'behavioral parity' across our models for two main flows: customer support summarization and sensitive-data redaction. Also they have an enterprise security questionnaire pending.

sahil_re: For summarization, we can usually match intent + length with a small prompt shim. Redaction is trickier — different models handle edge cases. We should plan for a small test set of 50 examples.

jess_ops: I'll need the test prompts+expected outputs to run side-by-side. Can sales collect them?

elaine_sales: On it. I'll ask Finova for 50 examples and a few 'must-pass' checks. ETA EOD today.

mike_se: Architecture question: VendorX uses a single /generate endpoint with JSON schema enforcement. Finova uses that heavily. We can provide a compatibility layer (simple adapter) that translates their calls to our SDK. Sample shim we used before:

```
// pseudo adapter
POST /vendorx/generate -> translate body.prompt -> call /v1/chat/completions
map model param -> recommended model (llama-2-13b -> rdx-13b-compat)
pass through max_tokens, stop, temperature
post-process: enforce output.schema if provided
```

sahil_re: Important: we need to keep response shapes identical when they assert schema. We'll add a strict post-processor that drops extra fields and fills missing keys with null. That covers most of the integration tests.

jess_ops: Security blockers from enterprise: SSO + Audit logs + Data residency. Finova needs SAML + ability to ship logs to their SIEM. We have an internal TODO in Redwood Private for SIEM forwarding — Tom, can infra enable a temporary webhook sink for the POC? @tom_infra

tom_infra: I can spin up a webhook sink in their VPC on our staging Private env. Need Finova CIDR and SAML certs. Also will enable request-level audit events for the POC. ETA 48 hours after we get creds.

elaine_sales: Pricing question — they asked if the migration would affect unit pricing. Short answer: hosted usage pricing same, but Dedicated/Reserved commitments can be adjusted. We should prepare an IO with an ephemeral discount for migration credits.

mike_se: Also flag to Finova: we may recommend a quantized model for cost parity with VendorX (they run 8-bit inference). That changes some edge-case outputs. We'll note this in the evaluation.

sec-bot: Security questionnaire received (Finova_1803_SecQ.pdf). Key items: SOC2 Type II, data at rest encryption, key management options, and RBAC.

jess_ops: I can draft answers for SOC2 + KMS; need contact in Finova for clarifying Q6 (retention policy for request logs).

elaine_sales: Action items: 1) Finova to share 50 examples + must-pass list (Elaine) 2) Tom to provision webhook & audit (Tom) 3) Mike/Sahil to build adapter shim + run side-by-side box (Mike/Sahil) 4) Jess to draft sec questionnaire answers (Jess). I'll cc Finova and propose kickoff for Tuesday.

mike_se: Timeline: adapter baseline + run 50 tests -> 2 dev days. If failures > 10% for must-pass, escalate to model tweak/temperature runs.

jess_ops: If we need schema-level exactness, we can add a strict schema enforcer as a short-term patch. Not ideal long-term but works for a POC.

elaine_sales: Sounds good. I'll ping Finova for credentials and the examples. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

tom_infra: Provision request noted. Please DM Finova contact and CIDR.

mike_se: FYI — I'll include a small experiment plan in the repo: mapping table + metrics: BLEU-ish for summarization, exact-match rate for schema outputs, and a redaction false negative rate.

elaine_sales: Final note: ask Finova whether they accept minor wording differences if intent preserved. That usually eases engineering burden. I'll try to get that confirmed in the kickoff.

jess_ops: +1. If they require exact wording, this will add runway and cost.

elaine_sales: End of thread — will update once Finova sends examples.
